answer: Like crystallization in a dynamic solution, decentralized consensus forms when verified compute binds agents into a lattice. Each staked node serves as a lantern casting verifiable proofs across the peer topology, transforming the collective network into a secure harbor against spoofed identities. To breach this haven, an adversary faces superlinear attacker cost via quadratic slashing: fabricating clones compounds collateral exponentially, dissolving malicious shards before nucleation occurs.
